meta.title: Charlotte Market Pulse dataset
meta.coverage_note: Values are exactly as published by Canopy Realtor® Association in its monthly press releases and its Housing Market Sortable Statistics pages. Nothing is estimated, interpolated or modeled. A null/missing value means Canopy did not publish that metric for that area and month in the sources collected.
meta.scope: Existing-home sales of single-family homes, condos and townhomes (per Canopy). Monthly figures are subject to revision as Canopy MLS data updates; older published values may differ slightly from figures in later reports.
meta.rounding_note: Some press releases state inventory as a rounded figure (e.g., "approximately 10,000" or "nearly 8,500"); those values are stored as published.
meta.region_definition: Canopy's Charlotte Region: Alexander, Anson, Cabarrus, Catawba, Cleveland, Gaston, Iredell, Lincoln, Mecklenburg, Rowan, Stanly and Union counties in NC; Chester, Chesterfield, Lancaster and York counties in SC (per Canopy press releases).
meta.production: At launch, monthly values are refreshed from Canopy releases (manual review) and per-neighborhood live stats come from Showcase IDX market reports built on Canopy MLS data.
